stories.title: Vodafone Idea and PwC launch Vi Intelligence Lab
stories.summary: Vodafone Idea has launched Vi Intelligence, a strategic initiative built with PwC India to develop and scale enterprise AI solutions. The carrier aims to drive AI-led transformation across its operations and for enterprise customers. The lab joins a crowded field of similar corporate AI launch announcements.

stories.title: KPMG reports rising risk exposure for global businesses
stories.summary: KPMG reports that 70 percent of global business leaders have seen increased risk exposure over the past two years. With 64 percent identifying AI as a primary disruption, the firm suggests that organisations must now prioritise supply-chain resilience to manage cyber threats and geopolitical uncertainty.

stories.title: McKinsey finds preparedness gaps in corporate threat management
stories.summary: A McKinsey report found that 87 percent of organisations faced a threat-related incident in the last 24 months. While most firms struggle with risks beyond cybersecurity, only 32 percent have capabilities for espionage. Responsibility remains fragmented across departments, leaving budgets and accountability to drift.

stories.title: 87% of organisations face threat-related incidents, preparedness gaps persist: McKinsey | Mint
stories.summary: New Delhi [India], November 4 (ANI): Around 87 per cent of organisations experienced at least one threat-related incident in the 24 months preceding a survey, but many remain inadequately prepared to deal with risks beyond conventional cybersecurity, according to a report by McKinsey & Company.

stories.summary: Accenture will correct a 2025 agriculture report after GPTZero identified 31 hallucinated citations across three papers linked to the consultancy. Accenture attributed the errors to human oversight rather than AI malfunctions. The firm declined to explain how it determined the cause of the nonexistent references.

stories.title: FAS expects to recoup McKinsey fees within six months
stories.summary: The Faculty of Arts and Sciences expects to recover its spending on McKinsey consultants in under six months following a staff restructuring. Dean Hopi E. Hoekstra confirmed the school eliminated roughly 150 positions to save $18.5 million annually. The exact cost of the consulting remains undisclosed.

stories.title: India faces shipbuilding output gap
stories.summary: India needs an 11-fold increase in shipbuilding output to compete with global leaders, according to a FICCI-EY report. Indian shipyards delivered 57,637 gross tonnes in 2025, while China, South Korea and Japan accounted for 94.2 percent of the global market. Vietnam currently produces 15 times more tonnage.

stories.title: Report links air pollution to 2 million deaths in India
stories.summary: A FICCI-EY report states that air pollution was linked to more than two million deaths in India during 2023. The study warns of significant impacts on cardiovascular health and the national economy, calling for stronger PM2.5 targets and improved healthcare preparedness throughout the year.

stories.title: Indian battery components face cost disadvantage
stories.summary: A government-backed study found that Indian battery components cost up to 61 percent more than imported alternatives. The report, prepared by NETRA and several research institutes, proposes three incentive options to help domestic manufacturers build a supply chain for advanced cell materials.

stories.summary: Bain & Company predicts GLP-1 drug usage will rise significantly by 2030, citing lower prices and fewer side effects as primary drivers. US usage is forecast to grow from 20 percent to 31 percent. The firm notes that adoption could be even higher than its current projections.

stories.summary: India needs a predictable, long-term demand pipeline for domestic vessels and better financing to grow its shipbuilding industry, according to a report by EY and FICCI. India repaired 418 vessels in FY23-24 across 42 dry docks. The country's global market share remains limited despite its strategic location.

stories.title: Cabinet approves 14,500 crore energy storage scheme
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a 14,500 crore rupee Viability Gap Funding scheme to support 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage capacity by FY 2030-31. The initiative aims to strengthen grid stability and integrate renewable energy. It will support 30 GWh of battery systems and 60 GWh of pumped storage.

stories.title: Government approves critical mineral processing scheme
stories.summary: The Cabinet has approved a 2,814 crore rupee Capex Support Scheme to boost domestic processing of critical minerals like lithium, nickel and cobalt. The initiative aims to reduce reliance on foreign supply chains for the EV, battery and defence sectors. Domestic processing is now a stated economic security priority.

stories.title: Modi directs NITI Aayog to focus on marginalised groups
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has asked the new NITI Aayog leadership to develop transformative ideas to improve the ease of living for marginalised people. The chairman urged officials to collaborate with research institutions and conduct ground-level reality checks to advance long-term development goals in aspirational districts and blocks.
